words.hintSo: Miro guduudan ama cagaaran oo macaan (Tufaax)
Cunto laga sameeyo bur iyo khamiir (Rooti)
Daruur cirka ku shareeran oo roob keenta
Hees ama dhawaaq muusig oo heersare ah
Geed yar oo ka baxa ciidda (Dhir)
Webi ama biyo socda oo dabiici ah
Qalab AI oo si toos ah u shaqeeya
Muhiim ah ama nolosha u dhow
Dareere lagama maarmaan u ah nolosha (Biyo)
